\begin{document}
At the resonant point the control parameter is fixed to $a=0$.  The paper
nevertheless asserts the finite-interval identity
\begin{equation}
\int_0^1 dx\, e^{a x}=\frac{e^a-1}{a}.\label{singular-parameter}
\end{equation}
No limiting prescription for the right-hand side is intended.
\end{document}
